description: This file defines a React component for rendering interactive charts using Plotly.js, including features like annotations, theme switching, dynamic data loading, and chart configuration. It manages state, handles user interactions, and integrates various utility functions and dialogs for a comprehensive charting interface.

classes.name: PlotComponent
classes.description: A React class component wrapping the Plotly chart, managing its state and updates.

methods.name: isScatterPlot
methods.description: Determines if the provided data represents a scatter plot for special annotation handling.

methods.name: debugAnnotation
methods.description: Logs detailed information about an annotation object for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getXRange
methods.description: Calculates and returns a date range for the x-axis based on provided min and max date strings.

methods.name: CreateDataXrange
methods.description: Filters and prepares chart data traces to match a specified x-axis range, optionally avoiding filtering animated frames.

methods.name: DynamicLoad
methods.description: Asynchronously loads data for the chart based on a specific x-axis range, useful for dynamic zoom and pan interactions.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a standardized string 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

methods.name: Chart
methods.description: Main React component that renders the Plotly chart with extensive interaction capabilities, theme controls, annotation management, and resizes handling.

methods.name: setPlotData
methods.description: Updates the chart data and triggers re-rendering.

methods.name: onDeleteAnnotation
methods.description: Removes a specified annotation from the chart.

methods.name: onAddAnnotation
methods.description: Initiates adding a new annotation with a popup interface.

methods.name: onChangeColor
methods.description: Updates the color of the selected shape in the chart.

methods.name: button_pressed
methods.description: Handles visual feedback when chart control buttons are pressed.

methods.name: autoscaleButton
methods.description: Toggles autoscaling behavior on the chart.
